definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining #primeTuple as the exact tuple-expression AST containing the finite prime-length constants; it introduces syntax and no operational transition or independent mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule #primeTuple
    => TupleExpr(
         Int(2),  Int(3),  Int(5),  Int(7),  Int(11),
         Int(13), Int(17), Int(19), Int(23), Int(29),
         Int(31), Int(37), Int(41), Int(43), Int(47),
         Int(53), Int(59), Int(61), Int(67), Int(71),
         Int(73), Int(79), Int(83), Int(89), Int(97))

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining #emitSelected as the source-level assignment AST that appends the current word and a space to result.
definitions.text:
rule #emitSelected
    => Assign(
         Name("result"),
         BinOp(
           "+",
           BinOp("+", Name("result"), Name("word")),
           Str(" ")))

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining #maybeEmit as the source-level conditional AST using len and membership in #primeTuple.
definitions.text:
rule #maybeEmit
    => If(
         Compare(
           Call(Name("len"), Name("word")),
           CmpOp("in", #primeTuple)),
         #emitSelected,
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining #scanBody as the exact loop-body AST for separator handling and character accumulation.
definitions.text:
rule #scanBody
    => If(
         Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str(" "))),
         #maybeEmit
         Assign(Name("word"), Str("")),
         Assign(
           Name("word"),
           BinOp("+", Name("word"), Name("char"))))

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining #wordsBody as the complete function-body AST assembled from initialization, the loop, final emission, and return.
definitions.text:
rule #wordsBody
    => Assign(Name("result"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("word"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("char"), Str(""))
       For(Name("char"), Name("sentence"), #scanBody)
       #maybeEmit
       Return(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "strip"), .Exprs))

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining #solutionModule as the module AST containing the words_in_sentence function with its exact parameter and #wordsBody.
Guarded simplification equation defining the true branch of the newly introduced primeLength predicate on the enumerated finite set.
definitions.text:
rule primeLength(N) => true
    requires N ==Int 2  orBool N ==Int 3  orBool N ==Int 5
      orBool N ==Int 7  orBool N ==Int 11 orBool N ==Int 13
      orBool N ==Int 17 orBool N ==Int 19 orBool N ==Int 23
      orBool N ==Int 29 orBool N ==Int 31 orBool N ==Int 37
      orBool N ==Int 41 orBool N ==Int 43 orBool N ==Int 47
      orBool N ==Int 53 orBool N ==Int 59 orBool N ==Int 61
      orBool N ==Int 67 orBool N ==Int 71 orBool N ==Int 73
      orBool N ==Int 79 orBool N ==Int 83 orBool N ==Int 89
      orBool N ==Int 97
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Complementary guarded simplification equation defining the false branch of the newly introduced primeLength predicate outside the enumerated finite set.
definitions.text:
rule primeLength(N) => false
    requires notBool (
      N ==Int 2  orBool N ==Int 3  orBool N ==Int 5
      orBool N ==Int 7  orBool N ==Int 11 orBool N ==Int 13
      orBool N ==Int 17 orBool N ==Int 19 orBool N ==Int 23
      orBool N ==Int 29 orBool N ==Int 31 orBool N ==Int 37
      orBool N ==Int 41 orBool N ==Int 43 orBool N ==Int 47
      orBool N ==Int 53 orBool N ==Int 59 orBool N ==Int 61
      orBool N ==Int 67 orBool N ==Int 71 orBool N ==Int 73
      orBool N ==Int 79 orBool N ==Int 83 orBool N ==Int 89
      orBool N ==Int 97)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Total equation defining emitWord as the accumulator update selected by primeLength; it names the mathematical summary used by the loop invariant.
definitions.text:
rule emitWord(W:IntSeq, O:IntSeq)
    => #if primeLength(isLen(W))
       #then seqConcat(seqConcat(O, W), iCons(32, .IntSeq))
       #else O
       #fi

definitions.rationale: Base recurrence equation defining scanOutput on an empty remaining IntSeq as the existing output accumulator.
Separator recurrence equation defining scanOutput by emitting the completed word, clearing the word accumulator, and descending on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule scanOutput(iCons(32, R:IntSeq), W:IntSeq, O:IntSeq)
    => scanOutput(R, .IntSeq, emitWord(W, O))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Non-separator recurrence equation defining scanOutput by extending the current word and descending on the tail under the complementary C != 32 guard.
definitions.text:
rule scanOutput(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), W:IntSeq, O:IntSeq)
    => scanOutput(R, seqConcat(W, iCons(C, .IntSeq)), O)
    requires C =/=Int 32
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base recurrence equation defining scanWord on an empty remaining IntSeq as the current word accumulator.
Separator recurrence equation defining scanWord by clearing the current word and descending on the tail.
Non-separator recurrence equation defining scanWord by appending the character and descending on the tail under C != 32.
definitions.text:
rule scanWord(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), W:IntSeq)
    => scanWord(R, seqConcat(W, iCons(C, .IntSeq)))
    requires C =/=Int 32
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base recurrence equation defining scanLast on an empty remaining IntSeq as the prior character value.
Recursive equation defining scanLast by recording the head as a one-character IntSeq and descending on the tail.
Total equation defining sentenceResult as the composition of the scan summaries, final emission, and the reference strip helpers revIS and trimWS.
definitions.text:
rule sentenceResult(CS:IntSeq)
    => revIS(
         trimWS(
           revIS(
             trimWS(
               emitWord(
                 scanWord(CS, .IntSeq),
                 scanOutput(CS, .IntSeq, .IntSeq))))))
